## What changed

## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `ci` / `chore` — tooling

## Sensitive areas touched

- [ ] Session engine (Rust)
- [ ] Persistence / import-export (Rust)
- [ ] Timer loop (frontend)
- [ ] Audio
- [ ] Globe / 3D rendering
- [ ] None of the above

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] Verified behaviour in the running app, not just in isolated components
- [ ] No new network calls introduced (offline constraint)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or architecture changed
